clock_provenance.how: run_on_device.py reads `cpu_start: cpu freq: <Hz>` out of the boot log the device prints on reset and writes it into the measurement as clock_mhz; it refuses to write an artifact whose clock it could not read.

results/quant/esp32_lejepa_160mhz.json.note: measured on an image built with CONFIG_ESP_DEFAULT_CPU_FREQ_MHZ_160; that image was replaced by the committed 240 MHz build afterwards

results/quant/esp32_lejepa_240mhz.json.note: measured on the committed image; reproduces the earlier 636.6825 ms run

clock_provenance.device_restored_to: results/quant/esp32_lejepa_240mhz.json's image (flash verified byte-for-byte against a pre-flash dump)

note: results/ is gitignored, so the raw per-run JSON lives there and this tracked copy carries the summary the report cites. Regenerate with firmware/tools/run_on_device.py.
